task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Robot navigates to the box stack, picks the top box (BOX_TOP) to access BOX_MIDDLE, then picks BOX_MIDDLE and places it on the INSPECTION_TABLE, restoring BOX_TOP on TEMP_TABLE to leave the stack with only the bottom and top boxes (middle removed).
assumptions: BOX_TOP is graspable and reachable when robot is near the stack.
The robot can navigate to the box stack location (2.0, -1.0) and then to the inspection table (-2.2, 2.0) and temp table (-2.2, -1.8).
The tolerance for navigation is set to 0.5 meters.
All objects are within interaction distance after navigation.
